en.askTitle: Put in your own job location, pass and ceiling and get the same dated room comparison and budget
en.runTitle: A Malaysian engineer’s first Singapore rental near one-north: S$7,000 a month, about S$2,000 for housing

fields.label: Nationality, pass and issue timing
fields.value: from Malaysia, on an Employment Pass

fields.label: All-in housing ceiling
fields.value: about SGD 2,000 a month for a room or studio

fields.label: Upfront cash
fields.placeholder: e.g. SGD 6,000 saved for deposit and moving

fields.label: Commute limit
fields.value: within about 35 minutes of one-north by MRT

fields.label: Bathroom, cooking and guest needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. own bathroom, can cook, occasional guests

en.template: Plan my first Singapore rental near {address} for {date}, with {pass}, {income}, {ceiling}, {cash}, {commute} and {needs}. Compare dated room adverts, separate rent/bills/deposit/duty/agent costs, flag approval and scam checks, and show a monthly budget. Plan only; do not contact, reserve or pay.

phases.title: Check current room listings and the official rental rules
phases.note: HDB and condo room adverts near one-north, plus HDB, IRAS and CEA rules
phases.judgment: It read the listing page itself rather than trusting the search result: one flat showed S$1,400 on its page against a stale S$1,500 in search, and another was tagged move-in ready but only free from 19 December 2026.

phases.title: Build the practical guide and a dated source list
phases.note: Costs, deposit and duty examples, scam checks and the monthly budget
phases.judgment: Where sources disagreed it chose the official one. A general renting guide was set aside because its stamp-duty formula conflicts with IRAS. An older official explainer said the extra occupancy allowance ends in 2026, so it used newer HDB and URA notices that run to 2028.

phases.title: Check the content, links and page layout, then deliver
phases.judgment: It said plainly what it could not find: no fresh self-contained studio was verified. The older S$2,200 studio is shown for comparison but left out of the recent-listing count, and commute times are labelled as estimates.

workers: Found and opened HDB common-room and master-room listings near one-north, noting rent, lease terms and availability dates
Found and opened condo room and studio listings in Dover, Buona Vista and nearby areas, noting rent, whether bills are included, and gaps

zh.askTitle: 换成你的工作地点、准证和预算上限，就能得到同样有日期的房源对比和月度预算
zh.runTitle: 马来西亚工程师在新加坡 one-north 附近首次租房：月薪 7,000 新元，住房约 2,000 新元

fields.label: 国籍、准证及签发时间
fields.value: 来自马来西亚，持就业准证（Employment Pass）

fields.label: 全包住房上限
fields.value: 房间或单间公寓，每月约 2,000 新元

fields.label: 前期现金
fields.placeholder: 例如：存了 6,000 新元，用来付押金和搬家

fields.label: 通勤上限
fields.value: 地铁到 one-north 约 35 分钟以内

fields.label: 卫浴、做饭和访客需求
fields.placeholder: 例如：想要独立卫生间，能做饭，偶尔有朋友来

zh.template: 请帮我规划{date}起、{address}附近的首次新加坡租房：国籍、准证及签发时间{pass}，收入{income}，全包住房上限{ceiling}，前期现金{cash}，通勤上限{commute}，卫浴、做饭和访客需求{needs}。比较有日期的房间广告，分清租金、账单、押金、印花税及中介费，列出批准和防诈骗检查，并做每月预算。只做计划，不联系、不留房、不付款。

phases.title: 查当前的房间房源和官方租房规则
phases.note: one-north 附近的组屋和公寓房间广告，以及 HDB、IRAS 和 CEA 的规定
phases.judgment: 它没有只信搜索结果，而是点开房源页逐条核对：有一套在页面上是 1,400 新元，搜索结果里过时的价格却是 1,500；另一套标着“可立即入住”，实际要到 2026 年 12 月 19 日才空出来。

phases.title: 写好实用指南，并列出带日期的来源
phases.note: 费用、押金和印花税算例、防诈骗检查和每月预算
phases.judgment: 来源之间不一致时，它以官方为准。一份通用租房指南因为印花税算法与 IRAS 不符被弃用；一份较早的官方说明写着放宽的入住人数限制 2026 年到期，它就改用 HDB 和 URA 较新的通知，有效期到 2028 年。

phases.title: 检查内容、链接和页面显示，交付
phases.judgment: 它如实写出没找到的东西：没能核实到近期有效的独立单间公寓。较早的 2,200 新元单间只作对照，不计入近期房源数量，通勤时间也都标成估算。

workers: 找出并打开 one-north 附近的组屋普通房和主人房房源，记下租金、租期和可入住日期
找出并打开 Dover、Buona Vista 等附近的公寓房间和单间公寓房源，记下租金、是否含杂费以及缺口
